public final class LmdbLegacyEmptyFixtureProducer {
 public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
  var config = new LmdbStoreConfig("spoc,posc,ospc").setTripleTermIndexes("spoc,cspo")
   .setTripleDBSize(64L * 1024).setValueDBSize(8L * 1024 * 1024)
   .setInlineLiterals(Boolean.parseBoolean(args[1])).setForceSync(true);
  var store = new LmdbStore(Path.of(args[0]).toFile(), config);
  store.init();

   connection.begin(IsolationLevels.NONE);
   if (connection.size() != 0) throw new AssertionError("New old-writer store must be empty");
   connection.commit();
  } finally { store.shutDown(); }
  System.out.println("FROZEN-610-EMPTY-V2-GREEN inline=" + args[1]);
 }
